question.text: The normality of $26 \%$ (wt/vol) solution of ammonia (density $=0.855$ ) is approximately:

solution.text:
Wt. of $\mathrm{NH}_{3}=26 \mathrm{~g}=\frac{26}{17} \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{eq}=1.53 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{eq}$

Vol. of soln. $=100 \mathrm{mc}=0.1 \mathrm{~L}$

$\therefore$ Normality $=\frac{1.53}{0.1}=15.3 \mathrm{~N}$
